title: Anthropic Raised More Than Any IPO Ever

sentences.text: Anthropic just pulled off the biggest IPO in history.
The maker of Claude sold its shares at $83 each.
Then Nasdaq trading opened, and the very first price was $111.50!
At that moment Anthropic was worth about $2 trillion, counting the stock promised to employees.
By the closing bell it had cooled to $97, still 17 percent up.
With the extra shares the banks bought, the sale raised $93.5 billion, more than SpaceX in June.
But one day later, a tech sell-off pushed it down 8.5 percent.
So is this the top of the AI boom, or just the start? Tell me in the comments.
